name: barbar
description: BarBar — מערכת ניהול תורים מקצועית למספרה

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run docker:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --workspace backend run dev" "npm --workspace frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace backend run build && npm --workspace frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --workspace backend run start" "npm --workspace frontend run start"
scripts.lint: npm --workspace backend run lint && npm --workspace frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --workspace backend run test && npm --workspace frontend run test
